text:
nina: Pitch: a mini "contingency header" that sits on rollout pages. One-line control to apply common fallback modes fast. Goal: <30s operator flow, clear audit. Thoughts? :rocket:
devon: Seems useful. Must show rollout id + route name so it's scoped. Also show the top matched signal summary inline (eg 5xx: 14%, p95: 1.2s).
sara: Operators need to see "what changes" and quick estimates: cost delta, invocation delta, and p99 delta. Little badges next to each mode.
lee: Important: require a justification textbox if the action escalates severity or toggles 'suppress-notify'. Record the text in the audit row.
nina: Controls I'll propose: Mode (soft-throttle | quarantine | fallback-model), Duration presets (15s/60s/5m/custom), Severity ladder (info/standard/escalated), Suppress-notify checkbox, Attach repro prompts checkbox if match tags include prompt-safety.
yara: Telemetry contract note: backend must emit deterministic breadcrumb ids and a short snapshot token. Suggested breadcrumb format: contingency:<YYYYMMDD>T<HHMMSS>:<rollout-id> and snapshot token like tb-20260322-003. No random UUIDs so decision-sim can replay.
devon: Also add a small undo affordance for 2 minutes and rate-limit applies/reverts per rollout (eg max 2 applies and 3 reverts per 10m) to avoid flapping. Show guards tooltip.
sara: For permissioning, only users with contingency.apply can escalate to "escalated" severity; disabled control with tooltip otherwise.
nina: Example audit line we'll log (human-readable): "nina applied quarantine to /v1/chat for 60s due to 5xx spike in us-west; breadcrumb=contingency:20260322T101530:rollout-314; snapshot=tb-20260322-003". And machine payload will include the same fields for replay.
lee: UI nit: sort matched signals by impact and default to showing top 3 with impact bars. Expand to raw counts and sample ids.
nina: Ops preview: https://console-preview.internal/contingency-header?pr=1602 (simulated signals).
ops-bot: Preview deployed. Note: simulated traffic includes prompt-safety tags so try attach repro checkbox.
yara: One more infra ask: include an "estimated uncertainty" tooltip for delta numbers (eg +/-5%) so operators understand noise.
sara: Sounds good. Nina, can you write a 1-page RFC with mock, telemetry contract (breadcrumb + snapshot), audit fields, rate-limits, undo rules, permission gating, and example payloads? I'll take it to ops sync.
nina: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
